items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: By me playing out with Pinkney and Johnson, Bill Johnson, the rest of them.

ctx.x: It's just the truth. How do college students drink now? Well, yes. Same as I don't know.

By me playing out with Pinkney and Johnson, Bill Johnson, the rest of them. Well, they said, come on, take a drink. It won't hurt you, boy. Well, I thought it was right to be obedient to those old men. Well, when I left the office, I ran away with the president's daughter, Dr. Jacksonville, when I got married by Dr. John E. Ford, Bethel Baptist Institutional Church in 1913. You want to cut it off for a minute?
